svg.title: How the content elementizer reads a file
svg.desc: The request is checked for file type. A PDF is checked for a password, converted to DOCX in batches in a separate process, and rejected if it has almost no text. A DOCX is optionally rendered with LibreOffice to find page numbers. Both are then read into a DocumentModel, and a heading index is built. The response holds the document and the file index.
